changes: Corrected the measured-token formula to SUM(i + o): cache read/write are a breakdown of input_tokens, not additions, so the previous SUM(i + o + cr + cw) counted cached context three times. Ships devbar-tokens.py, which 1.1.0 documented in four places but omitted, plus spec_docx_kit.py for Word specs with a working contents page, and an installable dashboard pre-commit hook via install-hooks.sh. Retains 1.1.0's Claude Code support and argument-hints; Cursor and Claude Code skills are now verified byte-identical at release time.
